
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rgw2010/p/22911418" title="发布于 2026-09-09 20:23">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ARC 杂题乱做</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="arc222e-xor-matching"><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/problem/AT_arc222_e" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">[ARC222E] XOR Matching</a></h2>
<p><a href="https://www.luogu.com.cn/article/bxbpeymx" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><strong>洛谷同步题解。</strong></a></p>
<p>*2400</p>
<p>给定长度为 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 的序列 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span>，有 <span class="math inline">\(a_i \in [0, 2^m - 1)\)</span>，定义 <span class="math inline">\(f(x)\)</span> 表示最多能将 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 中的多少对元素两两配对之后每对的两个数异或和为 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，需要求：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sum_{x = 0}^{2^m - 1} f(x) 10^x
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5, \ m \leq 20.\)</span></p>
<hr>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(cnt_i\)</span> 表示 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 中 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 的数量，那么显然：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(x) = \frac{1}{2} \sum_{i = 0}^{2^m - 1} \min(cnt_i, cnt_{i \oplus x})
\]</div><p></p><p>这是显然的，因为 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 只能和 <span class="math inline">\(i \oplus x\)</span> 配对，所以显然只能取两者数量较小的那个，注意 <span class="math inline">\(x = 0\)</span> 的时候需要特判，因为此时是 <span class="math inline">\(\lfloor \frac{cnt_i}{2} \rfloor\)</span>。</p>
<p>然后推式子（其中 <span class="math inline">\(c_i\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(cnt\)</span> 排序后的结果，然后 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(c_i\)</span> 原来是 <span class="math inline">\(cnt_{p_i}\)</span> 排序过来的）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned} \sum_{x = 1}^{2^m - 1} f(x) 10^x &amp;= \sum_{x = 1}^{2^m - 1} 10^x \frac{1}{2}\sum_{i = 0}^{2^m - 1} \min(cnt_i, cnt_{i \oplus x}) \\ &amp;=\frac{1}{2} \sum_{i = 0}^{2^m - 1} \sum_{j \ne i} \min(cnt_i, cnt_j) 10^{i \oplus j} \\ &amp;=\frac{1}{2} \sum_{i = 0}^{2^m - 1}\sum_{j \ne i} \min(c_i, c_j) 10^{p_i \oplus p_j}  \\ &amp;= \frac{1}{2}\sum_{i = 0}^{2^m - 1} \left( \left( \sum_{j &lt; i} c_j \cdot 10^{p_i \oplus p_j}\right) +\left( \sum_{j &gt; i} c_i \cdot 10^{p_i \oplus p_j} \right) \right) \\ &amp;= \frac{1}{2}\left( \sum_{i = 0}^{2^m - 1} c_i \sum_{j &gt; i} 10^{p_i \oplus p_j}\right) + \frac{1}{2}\left( \sum_{j = 0}^{2^m - 1} c_j \sum_{i &gt; j} 10^{p_i \oplus p_j}\right) \\ &amp;=  \sum_{i = 0}^{2^m - 1} c_i \sum_{j &gt; i} 10^{p_i \oplus p_j}\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>于是本质上只需要对每个 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span>，算出 <span class="math inline">\(\sum_{j &gt; i} 10^{p_i \oplus p_j}\)</span> 即可，显然你发现它等价于强制在线修改算异或卷积，即（设 <span class="math inline">\(h_i\)</span> 表示是否有 <span class="math inline">\(p_j\)</span> 等于 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span>）：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[ans_x = \sum_{i = 0}^{2^m - 1} 10^{x \oplus i} h_i = \sum_{i \oplus j = x} 10^j \cdot h_i
\]</div><p></p><p>即考虑 <span class="math inline">\(\{10^i\}\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(\{h\}\)</span> 的异或卷积的第 <span class="math inline">\(p_i\)</span> 位，就是 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 的答案，我们要支持的是单点修改 <span class="math inline">\(h\)</span>，于是朴素 poly 做法肯定没有，于是直接根号分治，有值的 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 只有 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 个，设块长为 <span class="math inline">\(B\)</span>，每经过 <span class="math inline">\(B\)</span> 位就先 FWT 暴力卷一次，然后每次查询 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 答案就是 <span class="math inline">\(ans_{p_i}\)</span> 再暴力遍历它后面最多 <span class="math inline">\(B\)</span> 个。</p>
<p>复杂度是 <span class="math inline">\(O(\frac{n}{B} 2^m m + n B) \ge O(n \cdot 2^{\frac{m}{2}} \sqrt m)\)</span>，可以通过。</p>
<p>轻微卡常。</p>


</div>
